Somebody taps your bumper. Your car is worth less forever.

Here is a thing that happens. Someone rear ends you at a light. Their insurance fixes the bumper. The car looks perfect. And it is now worth thousands less, because it has an accident on its history and buyers can read.
That gap is called diminished value. Your plan includes protection for it, up to $5,000, for one year from your start date. Its own contract number is {{{DV_CONTRACT}}}. It is on your welcome email too.

IF IT HAPPENS
1: Photos of the damage and the other plate, on the spot
2: Get the police or insurance report number
3: Call Ascent at 866-660-7003 with contract {{{DV_CONTRACT}}}
4: Ascent walks you through the claim

PROTECTED UNTIL: {{{DV_END_DATE}}}, up to $5,000 in diminished value, one year term. We will remind you before it ends. This is not something to think about until you need it.

Most people have never heard of diminished value until they try to sell a car with a repaired fender and get an offer that makes no sense. You now know. That is the whole email.
